description: Return metadata and associated series for a FRED release (e.g., Employment Situation, Consumer Price Index). Accepts a release_id integer or a release_search text query — release_search performs a substring match across all FRED releases; prefer release_id when you know the ID. Returns release name, link, scheduled dates, and a paginated list of its series. Provide exactly one of release_id or release_search.

release_id.description: Numeric FRED release ID. Provide this or release_search — not both.

release_search.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against release names. Provide this or release_id — not both.

series_limit.description: Max series to return for this release (default 20).

series_offset.description: Pagination offset for the series list.

name: fedreserve_get_release

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_input`: Neither release_id nor release_search was provided, or both were provided. `release_not_found`: release_id not found, or release_search matched no releases. `ambiguous_release_search`: release_search matched multiple releases with similar names. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

link.description: URL to the release press release when available.

press_release.description: True when FRED links to a press release.

scheduled_dates.description: Upcoming release dates (ISO 8601). May be empty when not yet scheduled.

search_alternatives.description: Other releases that matched the search when ambiguous_release_search was triggered. Use one of these IDs with release_id for an exact match.

items.description: One series belonging to this release.

series_count.description: Total series count for this release.

totalCount.description: Total series count for this release before pagination was applied.

title: Get FRED Release
